name: motif_query_schema
description: Returns the JSON Schema of a motif.query.v2 document: every op, source and column with its type, the phon and env pattern syntax, and the reserved kinds. With values=classes it instead lists the natural-class and feature names of the project's Baseline, for writing phon and env patterns.

values.description: Set to classes to list the project's natural-class and feature names instead of the schema.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
